rdfs:label: Class
rdfs:comment: The class of RDF classes — the meta-class whose instances are themselves classes (Person, Note, Activity, etc.).
notes: Foundational RDFS term. Every class definition in this registry is `@type: rdfs:Class`. Use as the value of `@type` when declaring a new class; pair with `rdfs:subClassOf` to position it in the class hierarchy. OWL ontologies use `owl:Class` (a subclass of rdfs:Class) for classes and class expressions; use that in OWL-DL contexts.

history.note: Added note and seeAlso for owl:Class (used for OWL-DL classes and class expressions).
